name: Court & Dynasties
description: Every character belongs to a noble house; the ruling house gains prestige from wars, wonders and long reigns and loses it with colonies, while rival houses feud. A council of five seats (spymaster, chancellor, marshal, steward, magistrate) lends its skills to counter-intelligence, diplomacy, fleet repair, taxes and stability; powerful nobles left without a seat grow ambitious. Discontented nobles form factions with demands and ultimatums. Successions follow the government's law (primogeniture, election, military acclamation) with heirs, regencies and succession crises; the ruler's legitimacy scales every plot. Court intrigue: agents scheme against characters (sway, blackmail, sabotage, assassination) and are traced through leads; secrets become hooks; houses exchange envoys, wards and spouses and hold claims on colonies; characters become friends, rivals and lovers. Includes Internal Security (its own flags).
